content.title: Black-Orange Action Cards | Identity Reset, Tool Sweep and Hero Lockup
content.summary: An adult salvage captain proves one breaker tool through black-orange action cards. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original identity remains fixed. + Graphic resets separate proof chapters. + Exactly one major weapon action occurs. + All detail cards map to the same tool geometry. + The final hero card uses only original copy and design.
quick_start.recommended_input: Create one clearly adult original salvage captain with split copper-black hair, cargo trousers and a magnetic breaker tool on a clean identity board. She completes one horizontal breaker sweep; a single amber arc follows the tool head and vanishes. Return to the full-body board with breaker grounded and exact original label VANTA / SALVAGE CAPTAIN.
required_anchors: One clearly adult original identity remains fixed.
All detail cards map to the same tool geometry.
The final hero card uses only original copy and design.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult salvage captain proves one breaker tool through black-orange action cards. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年原创动画角色的橙黑发色、服装与重型工具；白底身份板和黑橙文字场反复复位，每次只放行一个挥扫或持械姿态，终局回到完整角色板。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original identity remains fixed.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original identity remains fixed."

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Graphic resets separate proof chapters."

invariants.rule: Exactly one major weapon action occurs.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Exactly one major weapon action occurs."

invariants.rule: All detail cards map to the same tool geometry.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "All detail cards map to the same tool geometry."

invariants.rule: The final hero card uses only original copy and design.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final hero card uses only original copy and design."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
